tasks.label: entrega: teste de concorrência
tasks.detail: o comando único do README — sobe o Postgres, aplica o schema e prova o requisito 2

tasks.label: protótipo: bench (sobe tudo, mede e derruba)
tasks.detail: anexo, não entrega: mede o p99 da busca a 500 req/s
tasks.command: set -e; docker compose up -d --wait; npm run db:migrate; npm run seed > /dev/null; npm start > /tmp/fieldpro-api.log 2>&1 & API=$!; trap 'kill $API 2>/dev/null' EXIT; until curl -sf localhost:3000/saude > /dev/null; do sleep 0.5; done; npm run bench

tasks.label: protótipo: demo ponta a ponta
tasks.detail: ondas, edição versionada, aceites simultâneos e cap diário em ~20s
tasks.command: set -e; docker compose up -d --wait; npm run db:migrate; npm run seed > /dev/null; npm start > /tmp/fieldpro-api.log 2>&1 & API=$!; trap 'kill $API 2>/dev/null' EXIT; until curl -sf localhost:3000/saude > /dev/null; do sleep 0.5; done; ./demo.sh
